collision_energy.evidence: MS2 scans were performed in the Ion trap (Turbo) using a maximum injection time of 50ms, AGC target value of 15000 and fragmented using CID with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 35%.

Ions were fragmented using HCD with an NCE of 65% and analysed in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 15,000 at m/z 200, scan range of 110-500 m/z, AGC target value of 1x105 and a maximum injection time of 50 ms.

fractionation_method.evidence: For high pH reversed phase fractionation on a Dionex analytical HPLC, 50µg of pooled and purified TMT labelled samples were resuspended in 10mM ammonium-bicarbonate (ABC), 5%ACN, and separated on a 250mm long C18 column (Aeris Peptide XB-C18, 4.6mm ID, 2.6 µm particle size; Phenomenex) using a multistep gradient from 100% Solvent A (5% ACN, 10mM ABC in water) to 60% Solvent B (90% ACN, 10mM ABC in water) over 70 minutes.
